reviews.title: Is this WiFi 7 wireless router any good?
reviews.comment:
PROS:
- Really fast WiFi 7
- Pretty easy setup even without following the videos.
- Relatively inexpensive compared to other WiFi 7 routers that are double the price
- Monolithic stature design
- Has 2 additional LAN ports at the back
CONS:
- Plasticky and cheap to touch (but who really touches a router often anyways?)
- By real-world use, when I situated this inside our bedroom connected to a LAN outlet, the WiFi 7 speed begins to drop significantly at about 40-50  feet away
VERDICT
My 1Gb ATT connection is almost always at full duplex (~940Mb up and down), thanks to this relatively inexpensive WiFi 7 router. Now i have this reliable wireless connection at the opposite end of our house extending to the backyard.
reviews.author: The Reviewer™

reviews.title: Great Coverage and Fast
reviews.comment: First time I've owned a mesh system and this WiFi system works well. Good range coverage and fast. I love the strong connection throughout the house.

reviews.title: Great / Easy Mesh system
reviews.comment: Great mesh system. Super easy setup. Took away a star because even tough I set up the same SSID and password, I had to log in all my devices again. Although I have heard that could be a wifi 7 thing.

reviews.title: Works Flawlessly!!! Love it!
reviews.comment: Excellent product! Very easy to set up. So far it works flawlessly. My home WiFi has never been so fast. I’m finally able to take advantage of the faster WiFi speed I’m paying for.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.comment: for three weeks the units ran ok. Then my Wi-Fi suddenly just stopped working. I rebooted all nodes and all was fine two weeks later the same thing ..... another reboot! One week later same problem! this went on for another few weeks rebooting  every five or six days. Also noticed the nodes would have to be unplugged and replugged for them to communicate. So i was glad to see an update available. After the update the units became so unreliable  that i would reboot at least once a day. This product is really a waste of time! I would steer clear and purchase another brand
reviews.author: great white north
